name: data-science-experimentation
description: Use when the user asks whether an A/B test result is statistically significant, sample size and power for an experiment, CUPED, sequential testing, sample ratio mismatch, multiple comparisons or bandits. Produces design, power calculation and analysis. Not for product A/B test strategy (use product-ab-testing) or observational causal studies (use data-science-causal-inference).
